`CRS.parquet`, `crdf_recipient.parquet` and `crdf_provider.parquet` have the column layouts of the bulk CRS parquet (`CRS.parquet`, release v20261006) and of `oda_reader.download_crdf(perspective=..., pre_process=True)` (oda-reader 1.12.0, live layouts of June 2026). Every row is hand-built: ids, project numbers, titles and amounts are invented, and the codes are real DAC codes. The rows cover a repeated CRS record, a core contribution, a private foundation's Bi_Multi 6 outflow, a bilateral donor with one Bi_Multi 6 record, a grant-equivalent-only record, records with no amount or outside the CRS years, development-bank climate components with and without a published share, IFAD's 40% significant share, an Excel error in place of a title, two project numbers Excel turned into dates (one with a CRS record to repair it from, one without), an EIB row for each id scheme, and an imputed multilateral contribution in the provider perspective.
